- Game Hub: the open 3D case no longer shows a console-coloured band on the booklet or the disc, the inside of an Xbox case is green, and a leftover black 3D layer is closed after Back.
- File windows (Windows 7 and 11): a long press on a file or folder opens a menu (Open, Copy, Cut, Paste, Add to desktop, Rename, Delete); copy or cut in one window and paste in another to copy or move between windows.
- File windows: a physical keyboard works (Ctrl+C / X / V, Delete, F2, Enter, Backspace, Alt+Left).
- Floating keyboard: tapping the handle (the X beside it) closes it, it is wider (92 percent, like the normal keyboard), and its window lets touches through to the app behind it.
- Windows 7 explorer: more room between the address bar and the search box.
- Desktop: icons are spaced wider by default (the spacing setting goes up to 160%).
